name: Skyline views
description: Free or famous spots for a skyline shot. Golden hour is the best time for a bugg.

properties.name: Reunion Tower
properties.note: Dallas from the top of the ball; the light show starts at dusk.

properties.name: Margaret Hunt Hill Bridge
properties.note: Walk the Trinity Skyline Trail side for the downtown view.

properties.name: Top of the Rock
properties.note: Three decks with Central Park on one side and the Empire State on the other.

properties.name: Brooklyn Bridge Park
properties.note: Lower Manhattan across the water, free, best at sunset.

properties.name: Sky Garden
properties.note: Free tickets released weekly; book ahead.

properties.name: Primrose Hill
properties.note: A protected view over central London from the top of the hill.

properties.name: Lekki-Ikoyi Link Bridge
properties.note: The Lagos skyline across the lagoon, lit up after dark.
